'''Marianna Pensky''' is a professor at the [[University of Central Florida]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sciences.ucf.edu/math/group/fullrprofessor/|title=Full Professor Archives - Mathematics|website=Mathematics|access-date=2018-11-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181126092606/https://sciences.ucf.edu/math/group/fullrprofessor/|archive-date=2018-11-26|url-status=dead}}</ref>
Her research interests lie in the areas of theoretical and applied [[statistics]].

In 1995, Pensky became the first woman faculty in UCF Department of Mathematics.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Dudenhoefer '17 |first=Nicole |date=2023-03-30 |title=Meet UCF’s 4 Pegasus Professors for 2023 |url=https://www.ucf.edu/news/meet-ucfs-four-pegasus-professors-for-2023/ |access-date=2026-06-25 |website=University of Central Florida News {{!}} UCF Today |language=en-us}}</ref> Her work at University of Central Florida serves as a role model for women in mathematics and STEM fields. She has served on numerous MSc and Doctoral committees. In 2023, she was designated as a Pegasus Professor, the highest university award by UCF.<ref name=":0" /> Her work ranged in focus from computer science, statistical genetics and population biology.<ref name=":1" />

She is author of ''The Stress-strength Model and Its Generalizations: Theory and Applications'' ([[World Scientific Publishing]], 2003).

She is a Member of the Steering Committee of the International Society for NonParametric Statistics (ISNPS)(? -2026).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} International Symposia on Nonparametric Statistics (ISNPS) |url=https://imstat.org/ims-groups/international-symposia-on-nonparametric-statistics-isnps/ |access-date=2026-06-25 |language=en}}</ref> In 2020, Pensky was inducted as a Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/|title=Honored IMS Fellows|accessdate=2020-07-01}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Kyle |date=2020-06-12 |title=Math Professor Inducted As Fellow of Institute of Mathematical Statistics |url=https://sciences.ucf.edu/news/math-professor-inducted-as-fellow-of-institute-of-mathematical-statistics/ |access-date=2026-06-25 |website=College of Sciences News}}</ref> Pensky serves as an executive editor of the Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Editorial board - Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference {{!}} ScienceDirect.com by Elsevier |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-statistical-planning-and-inference/about/editorial-board |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231010043534/https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-statistical-planning-and-inference/about/editorial-board |archive-date=2023-10-10 |access-date=2026-06-25 |website=www.sciencedirect.com |language=en-us}}</ref>

Pensky was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/docs/default-source/amstat-documents/pdfs/fellows/Fellows2023.pdf|title=Fellows 2023|publisher=American Statistical Association|access-date=2023-06-14}}</ref>
